tasks.title: Validate graphql-cop with Netflix DGS
tasks.description: Run full E2E test on Netflix/dgs-examples-java PR #196 to verify graphql-cop analyzes GraphQL schemas.

tasks.title: Find SpotBugs Test Repository
tasks.description: Find a Java repo with actual bugs that SpotBugs can detect (null dereferences, resource leaks, etc.).
steps: Search GitHub for repos with known SpotBugs issues
Try spotbugs/spotbugs (has findbugsTestCases with intentional bugs)
Try WebGoat/WebGoat (intentionally vulnerable Java app)
Run test and verify SpotBugs finds >= 1 bug
Document the test repo and findings
tasks.result: SUCCESS! apache/commons-io: 125 findings (1 high, 124 medium). Patterns: CT_CONSTRUCTOR_THROW (78), AT_STALE_THREAD_WRITE (11), EI_EXPOSE_REP2 (10), DM_DEFAULT_ENCODING (1 high).

tasks.title: Find dependency-check Test Repository
tasks.description: Find a Java repo with known CVE vulnerabilities in dependencies (Log4j, Spring 4.x, etc.).
steps: Search for repos with outdated Log4j 2.x (CVE-2021-44228)
Search for repos with Spring Framework 4.x vulnerabilities
Check OWASP/dependency-check test fixtures
Run test and verify dependency-check finds >= 1 CVE
Document the vulnerable dependencies found
tasks.result: SUCCESS! Created test project with vulnerable deps. Found 55 CVEs (12 critical, 24 high). Top: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228), Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965), Text4Shell (CVE-2022-42889). Used Grype as scanner (NVD API rate limited).

tasks.title: Fix JDepend Compilation Issue
tasks.description: Investigate and fix why JDepend cannot find compiled .class files.
steps: Read jdepend-scanner.ts to understand current implementation
Check where JDepend looks for .class files
Investigate auto-compilation output directory
Fix path configuration or ensure build runs first
Test with any Java repo and verify JDepend produces metrics
tasks.result: FIXED! Added source-based fallback in runJDepend(). Uses javaArchitectureRunner.runSourceBasedAnalysis() when no .class files. Tested on spring-petclinic: found 4 high-efferent-coupling issues from source analysis.
